ingredients_inci: Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ceramide Np, Stearic Acid, Retinol, Ascorbic Acid, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Tocopheryl Acetate, Cetearyl Alcohol, Parfum, Dimethicone, Niacinamide, Acetyl Hexapeptide-8, Allantoin, Glyceryl Stearate, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Xanthan Gum.
directions: After cleaning and drying your skin, Apply a few drops on your face and neck and massage gently. Avoid appliying on around eyes. Recommended to use at every night.
purpose_from_pack: With Retinol, Ceramide and Niacinamide included in the formula, it helps enhance appearance of fine lines & wrinkles on the skin. Ideal for helping to protect and renew the skin against signs of aging. It aims to make the skin look more youtful, lively and smooth.
warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of contact, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water. Keep out of reach of children. Contains vitamin A. Consider your daily intake before use.
label_company_on_pack: L B İÇ VE DIŞ TİCARET KOZMETİK A.Ş. (İstanbul, Kadıköy)
